definitions.explanation: A sculptural representation of a person, animal, or deity.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}に{銅|どう}{像|ぞう}が{建|た}っている。
examples.english: A bronze statue stands in the park.

examples.japanese: {仏|ほとけ}{像|ぞう}を{拝|おが}む。
お{寺|てら}には{古|ふる}い{仏|ぶつ}{像|ぞう}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many old Buddha statues at the temple.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}に{映|うつ}った{自分|じぶん}の{像|ぞう}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw my own image reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: カメラの{映|えい}{像|ぞう}がぼやけている。
{画|が}{像|ぞう}ファイルのサイズが{大|おお}きすぎて、{送|おく}れなかった。
examples.english: The image file was too large and couldn't be sent.

notes:
Often used as a suffix to indicate the type of statue or image.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{銅|どう}{像|ぞう} (bronze statue)
・{石|せき}{像|ぞう} (stone statue)
・{仏|ぶつ}{像|ぞう} / {仏|ほとけ}{像|ぞう} (Buddha statue)
・{彫|ちょう}{像|ぞう} (carved statue, sculpture)
・{胸|きょう}{像|ぞう} (bust)
・{映|えい}{像|ぞう} (image, video)
・{画|が}{像|ぞう} (image, picture)
・{想|そう}{像|ぞう} (imagination)

HOMOPHONE:
・{象|ぞう} (elephant)
